subject: SIG: HSM operator snapshot, TLS cipher inventory, and rotation attestations
messages:
From: Oliver Shaw <oliver.shaw@glacierbank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@glacierbank.com, security@glacierbank.com
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG/CAIQ follow-up: encryption artifacts for Glacier Bank

Hi Jonas,

Following up on our SIG review for Glacier Bank — a few specific artifacts would help us close the cryptography section quickly. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following items by next Friday (2027-12-16)?

- HSM operator snapshot (current roster with operator roles and last access times) — redacted if necessary
- KMS key rotation log for the last 12 months (time-stamped events, key IDs, operator/automated actor) — sample export is fine if full logs are sensitive
- HSM attestation/certification (FIPS/third-party attestation PDF)
- TLS cipher inventory for in-transit endpoints used by tenant traffic and control plane (list of ciphers and protocols by service)
- KMS access matrix (role -> permissions, any cross-tenant separation notes)

If you prefer, we can accept a redacted set for operator names and a secure walkthrough instead of raw logs. We also want to schedule a 45-minute walkthrough with your security/ops team to review artifacts (screen share + Q&A). Proposed times: Tue 2027-12-15 13:00 PST or Wed 2027-12-16 09:00 PST.

Please let me know available contacts and how you prefer to deliver the files (SFTP, secure Drive link, or vendor portal).

Thanks,
Oliver Shaw
Senior Security Analyst | Glacier Bank
security@glacierbank.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2027 08:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG/CAIQ follow-up: encryption artifacts for Glacier Bank

Forwarding Glacier's request — Oliver is asking for HSM operator snapshot + KMS rotation exports + TLS cipher inventory + HSM attestation + access matrix.

Attachment: redwood-kms-architecture-diagram.pdf (initial diagram to help scope).

Action items I need help with:
- Marissa: can you extract rotation-events-sample.csv (12-month window), include key IDs and event timestamps; redact operator identifiers unless Laura says otherwise.
- Laura: can you pull the HSM attestation (FIPS cert / third-party report) and confirm what we can share openly vs under NDA; also advise on operator roster redaction policy.
- Ben: procurement might need to coordinate delivery method and NDAs — can you own the SFTP/secure-drive setup and liaise with Glacier procurement?

Target to Oliver: confirmation + propose the Dec 15 walkthrough. Please reply with ETA for artifacts; Glacier asked for Dec 16 delivery but we'll push for earlier.

Thanks,
Jonas
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Shaw <oliver.shaw@glacierbank.com>
Cc: procurement@glacierbank.com
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up: encryption artifacts for Glacier Bank

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the items you requested. High-level plan and options:

1) Artifacts we can prepare this week (samples / redacted):
   - rotation-events-sample.csv (12 months, key IDs + timestamps + actor type) — we can redact human operator names and show automated/system actors by default
   - hsm-attestation-fips140-2.pdf (vendor attestation) — full PDF available
   - kms-access-matrix.xlsx (role -> permissions) — redacted where appropriate
   - TLS cipher inventory (service-by-service CSV)

2) Delivery method: secure Drive link (we'll limit access via token), or SFTP transfer to a Glacier-owned bucket. Ben can spin up the SFTP transfer if you prefer.

3) Operator roster: we typically provide an "operator snapshot" that includes role (e.g., HSM_Admin, HSM_Operator) and last access timestamp; we redact personal identifiers unless Glacier has an executed NDA or explicit request for full names.

I've attached an initial diagram (redwood-kms-architecture-diagram.pdf) to help your reviewers understand where these artifacts come from. If the reviewer needs full audit trails instead of a sample, we can arrange a secure on-site or screen-shared session with redaction controls.

Proposed walkthrough: Tue 2027-12-15 13:00 PST — works for our ops/security leads. If that works for you, we'll send a calendar invite and attach artifacts ahead of time.

Jonas Weber
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-kms-architecture-diagram.pdf (diagram, stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Dec 2027 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG/CAIQ follow-up: encryption artifacts for Glacier Bank

Thanks for the heads-up, Jonas. Team notes and deliverable commitments below:

We will prepare the following artifacts and have them staged by COB Mon 2027-12-14:
- rotation-events-sample.csv (12 months) — columns: event_time, key_id, event_type, actor_type, actor_id_redacted. We will provide a separate mapping file under NDA if Glacier requires full operator names.
- hsm-attestation-fips140-2.pdf — pull the latest vendor attestation and include the scope page
- kms-access-matrix.xlsx — includes role names, permissions, and a short note on separation controls
- tls-cipher-inventory.csv — service, endpoint, port, TLS version, ciphers enabled

Delivery method: we'll upload to the secure Drive folder (link below) and provide one-time view tokens. Ben will coordinate the Drive access with Glacier procurement.

Redaction policy: operator identifiers will be pseudonymized in the CSV (OPERATOR_###) unless the legal team approves release of personal data. We can execute a narrow NDA amendment if Glacier needs full names.

Related artifacts/tickets:
- SEC-4821: create rotation export job and record filters (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4821)
- Drive folder (staging): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-glacier-evidence

If schedule holds we can confirm artifacts by 2027-12-14 and meet Tue 2027-12-15 13:00 PST for the walkthrough.

Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachments to produce: rotation-events-sample.csv, hsm-attestation-fips140-2.pdf, kms-access-matrix.xlsx, tls-cipher-inventory.csv

From: Oliver Shaw <oliver.shaw@glacierbank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@glacierbank.com, security@glacierbank.com
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2027 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up: encryption artifacts for Glacier Bank

Jonas / Laura — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear plan. Dec 15 13:00 PST works for the walkthrough; please send a calendar invite and the Drive link when the artifacts are staged.

A few clarifications before we meet:
- The pseudonymized operator IDs are fine for our SIG reviewer; full names only if we execute the mapping under an NDA.
- For rotation-events-sample.csv we will review key IDs and timestamps — we do not need raw token content.
- For TLS inventory, a high-level CSV is sufficient; we may request a brief note on mitigation for any weak/legacy cipher entries.

I'll ask our procurement team (cc'd) to coordinate the SFTP token if you prefer that over Drive. Otherwise, Drive with limited-time access is acceptable.

Thanks — sending calendar confirmation now.

Oliver Shaw
Senior Security Analyst | Glacier Bank
oliver.shaw@glacierbank.com

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=glacier-walkthrough-20271215
